title: Fixed times to check late pickups and late deliveries
keywords: late pickup check time late delivery check shopee lazada 11.15 2.30 4pm 7.30
body: Shopee/Lazada: AM late pickups at 11.15am; AM late deliveries at 2.30pm; PM late pickups at 4pm; PM late deliveries at 7.30pm.
TikTok: watch afternoon routes 5.30–7.30pm and evening routes 8–10.30pm; warn buyers of a late delivery before they chase.
Telemedical: hourly At Risk check from 10am so there are no late pickups or deliveries.
